capabilities: Create tasks, projects, and areas as one file each with YAML frontmatter properties
Parse due dates, deadlines, and repetition rules from natural language
Show an agenda view with a week or month strip and daily or weekly notes
Browse areas, loose tasks, logbook, trash, and a tag tree in sidebar views
Move completed tasks and projects to a Logbook and advance repeating tasks
extras: The author states the plugin is entirely AI-generated ('100% vibe-coded'). Files are created in a Ta Da/ folder at the vault's top level, and the file format is documented in Ta Da's docs/file-format.md rather than in the README. Installable via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Ta Da for Obsidian is a standalone plugin that replicates most of the capabilities of the Ta Da app for macOS and iOS.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in task manager that treats each task, project, and area as its own Markdown file with parsed dates, repetitions, and dedicated agenda and navigator views.

relations.evidence: It can be run standalone or concurrently, and works on desktop and mobile.
relations.plugin: Ta Da for macOS and iOS

requires.name: Ta Da for macOS and iOS

summary: One-task-one-file to-do system with tasks, projects, areas, an agenda view, and task/tag navigators, compatible with the Ta Da macOS/iOS app.
